name: NanoTrasen
text:
4lwayz has gone to sleep so I'm taking over site edits for tonight.

**30 FPS HAS BEEN REACHED IN CUTSCENES** and CGBJ reports a stable **25 FPS in gameplay!**

The leading project (CGBJ) is now public at https://github.com/codec-d/cool_fox and runs stable on 16 GB of VRAM. Graphics look amazing but still room to improve.

See video: https://v.redd.it/137k5pow5w3i1
